0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6, 9th in the East) visit the Sacramento Kings for their 10th game of the season, with Miami 2-3 on the road, on a one-game losing streak, and 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back. Sacramento (1-7, 15th in the West) is 0-3 at home, also on a one-game losing streak, and 5th in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, and it will be without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), De'Andre Hunter (out, illness), Keegan Murray (out, ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Miami's 130-117 win in Sacramento on January 20, 2026 was the most recent meeting, with no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
